description: AI translation of up to 8,000 characters into a target language given as an ISO 639-1 code or English name (with optional region or script, e.g. pt-BR, zh-Hant). Returns the translated text, detected source language, target language, character counts and a truncation flag. Machine translation by Anthropic Claude under a fixed Kit Rx prompt that asks it to keep formatting, numbers, URLs and names; may contain errors; not a certified translation. Price: $0.005 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged. AI-generated answer; a call with no arguments returns the stored example answer without a model call.

from.description: Source language in the same forms as to. Detected automatically when omitted.

text.description: Text to translate, up to 8000 characters (URL-encoded in the query string). Line breaks and Markdown are preserved.
examples: Our office will be closed on Monday for the holiday. Orders placed over the weekend will ship on Tuesday.

to.description: Target language: ISO 639-1 code (es, ja, zh, de) or English name (Spanish, Japanese), optionally with a region or script subtag (pt-BR, zh-Hant, es-419).

name: text_translate
title: AI text translation into 180+ languages
